Thanks, I've recorded that. The old memory said to release by pushing a `vYYYY.MM.N` tag on main and letting CI publish. I replaced it with a new one saying releases now go through `make release`, which tags and publishes, and still never by hand.

The `Makefile` on `main` (commit `48baf91`) doesn't have a `release` target yet. It only has `test` and `test-fast`. The target might be on another branch or not merged yet. I noted this in the memory. Let me know if you want me to add the target, or if it lives somewhere else and I should point the memory there.
